arguments.root_cause_statement: The Service shop/catalog selects pods with label app=catalog-api, but the Deployment shop/catalog stamps its pods with app=catalog. No pod in the namespace carries app=catalog-api, so the endpoint controller populates no addresses for the Service and its Endpoints object has no subsets. Both catalog pods are Running and Ready and the container logs show the API serving on :8080, which is why the Deployment reports 2/2 while every connection the storefront gateway makes to the catalog ClusterIP has nothing behind it and fails ("gateway: catalog fetch FAILED (timeout or connection refused)"). Fixing the incident means editing the Service selector back to app=catalog so it matches the pod template labels.
arguments.mechanism: The Service shop/catalog has .spec.selector set to {app: catalog-api}, while the pods that back it are labelled app=catalog, so the selector matches zero pods and the endpoint controller writes an Endpoints object for catalog with no addresses; traffic sent to the Service ClusterIP 10.96.96.22:8080 has no backend to be routed to and the connection fails.

evidence.claim: The paged Service has zero endpoint addresses while its pods are all Ready.
The Service selector asks for app=catalog-api.
The Deployment's pod template labels the pods app=catalog, not catalog-api.
The Endpoints object for catalog contains no subsets/addresses.
The storefront gateway's calls to the catalog Service do not complete.
evidence.quote: gateway: catalog fetch FAILED (timeout or connection refused)

ruled_out.alternative: The catalog pods themselves are broken or not serving on port 8080.
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The catalog container logs show the API listening on :8080 and both pods report ready with no restarts.

ruled_out.alternative: Readiness failures are removing otherwise matching pods from the Endpoints list.
ruled_out.ruling_claim: Both catalog pods are Running with the api container ready=True and zero restarts, so readiness is not what emptied the endpoint list.
ruled_out.quote: pod/catalog-65498fccb-g52gl phase=Running labels={app=catalog, pod-template-hash=65498fccb} node=incident-lab-control-plane api(ready=True,restarts=0)

ruled_out.alternative: A NetworkPolicy in shop is blocking gateway-to-catalog traffic.
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The namespace contains only configmaps and a serviceaccount besides the workloads and Service; no NetworkPolicy objects were captured.

verification.command: kubectl -n shop get service catalog -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'
kubectl -n shop get endpoints catalog -o yaml
